line.comment: * Task 1329.
* Add-Ons 2.2: The old approach did not account for those infectees or underequipped/unequipped infectees.
* This script has been improved to handle the matryoshka effect and potential player exploits regarding equipment or nesting.
* Zero Hour 1.10
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: If insured (non-OCV ships built during the virus event), the base offset (variance) is reduced by 85% on hard (70% on insane).
* Never happens on easy/normal (negative events cannot occur with insurance policy); just in case.
* Hard: Reduces offset by 85%.
* Insane: Reduces offset by 70%.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Removed obsolete RNG workaround.
* Randomize infection timing by +/- the ship quality offset.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Duration reduced by 30% on insane.
* Final safety clamp: make sure it doesn’t go below 600 seconds, regardless of difficulty.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Debug mode runs this script at 5min.
* ===== This timer runs until infection time or attacking the Xenon/OCV, whichever occurs sooner. =====
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: A broadcast takeover forces this infection to mature.
* ZH 1.10 - Infected OCV-built ships immediately trigger takeover if ordered to attack Xenon or OCV targets.
* Non-OCV ships infected by the Terraformer Virus event must mature normally.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Attacking Xenon or OCV immediately matures the infection.
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Non-OCV infected ships that were built during a terraformer virus event while the Outpost was insured will now show a (!) in the name. Checked once per minute.
* If the warning is not present (player renamed ship, fleet rename, etc.), then we append the warning.
* ===== Time's up. Infection has matured. =====
* Determine the ship's current sector.
* The takeover has matured. Preserve this state independently of Mayhem.Task.OCVVirus, because the resolver runs asynchronously.
* Current player ship cannot be converted yet.
* Resolve everything else immediately.
* Player may have moved the deferred ship to another sector.
* Resolve this ship and anything else currently eligible in its sector.
* Should never reach here.
